brandbook.motif: El bolsillo plegado sugiere contener y ordenar gastos. Se utiliza discretamente en la esquina del resumen, separado de cifras y mensajes. Los bordes laterales de selección vinculan el registro con el editor sin añadir tarjetas.

pages.title: Defining
pages.summary: Define the identity through a clear working sequence: name, filtered total, category filter, records and editor. The pocket suggests containment without turning the interface into an illustration.

examples.text: Show Total filtrado above the shared table/editor region. Keep confirmation beside the save action.

pages.title: Vision & Mission
pages.summary: Use the supplied product purpose rather than inventing a corporate mission. Describe the intended task and scope; do not promise savings, financial advice or permanent access.

examples.text: Una pantalla para registrar y consultar gastos en COP.
examples.title: Purpose statement

examples.text: Agrega, edita, elimina con confirmación y filtra por categoría. No necesitas una cuenta.
examples.title: Scope statement

pages.title: Brand Values
pages.summary: Treat clarity, continuity and restraint as design principles for this project, not asserted company values. Make every principle visible in a specific interface decision.

examples.text: Name the action Guardar cambios and show COP beside amounts; avoid vague labels such as Listo.
examples.title: Clarity

examples.text: Keep the selected record and editor linked during validation, saving, conflict and recovery.
examples.title: Continuity

examples.text: Use one total band, not a dashboard of competing metric cards.
examples.title: Restraint

pages.title: Tone of Voice
pages.summary: Write brief, concrete Spanish. Name the action and distinguish draft, pending, uncertain and saved states. Use calm explanations instead of technical jargon or celebratory claims.

examples.text: Gasto guardado. Puedes agregar otro gasto.
examples.title: Confirmed

examples.text: No pudimos confirmar el resultado. Recupera el envío original antes de continuar.
examples.title: Uncertain

examples.text: Escribe un importe mayor que cero.
examples.title: Invalid

pages.title: Logo
pages.summary: Introduce the logo chapter on Steady Green. Show the complete symbol on Quiet Paper and the name in white outside that support surface.

examples.text: Un bolsillo abierto y un pliegue diagonal identifican la herramienta.
examples.title: Bolsillo Gastos

examples.text: Keep the pocket and business name visually paired, with no extra badge, slogan or container around the name.
examples.title: Chapter composition

pages.title: Logo overview
pages.summary: The identity has two elements: a geometric folded pocket and the separately typeset name. Preserve the master silhouette and its open upper edge.

examples.text: Use the green pocket beside Bolsillo Gastos in IBM Plex Sans 600.
examples.title: Full signature

examples.text: Use the pocket alone for the app icon; retain Bolsillo Gastos as its accessible name.
examples.title: Compact signature

pages.title: Primary logo
pages.summary: Place the pocket to the left of Bolsillo Gastos. Use natural letter spacing, mixed case and a 12 px gap in the app header. Keep both elements vertically centered.

examples.text: Pair a 32 px symbol with the 28 px name on desktop. Keep the lockup on one line wherever it fits.
examples.title: Header lockup

examples.text: At 390 px, use a 28 px symbol and a 24 px name if needed. Preserve the full business name.
examples.title: Compact header

pages.title: Logo Safezone
pages.summary: Keep clear space equal to one quarter of the symbol width around the complete lockup. Measure from visible artwork and type, not the SVG canvas.

examples.text: Reserve at least 8 px around the lockup; use the larger 16 px page margin at mobile edges.
examples.title: 32 px symbol

examples.text: Keep the decorative pocket at least 12 px from the total and counter. Never position it behind numbers.
examples.title: Summary corner

pages.title: Color combinations
pages.summary: Use the green symbol and Deep Ink name on Quiet Paper or white. On green or ink backgrounds, preserve the symbol on a Quiet Paper support surface and set the name in white.

examples.text: Pocket #246348; name #202A25; background #F7F8F2.
examples.title: Light header

examples.text: Keep the green pocket on #F7F8F2 and the white name beside it. Do not recolor the master symbol.
examples.title: Dark cover

pages.title: Brandmark
pages.summary: The pocket combines an open container with a detached triangular fold. Reuse the exact master geometry in the header, summary corner, favicon and raster app icon.

examples.text: Keep the upper-right triangle separate from the pocket outline. Its diagonal is the distinctive detail.
examples.title: Recognizable fold

examples.text: Use the symbol without lettering at icon sizes. Do not add coins, currency signs or initials.
examples.title: Small-scale use

pages.title: Logo misuse
pages.summary: Do not stretch, rotate, outline again or crop the pocket. Never turn it into a currency badge or replace the business name with an abbreviation.

examples.text: Use Bolsillo Gastos, not BG, BolsilloGastos or BOLSILLO GASTOS in the primary lockup.
examples.title: Preserve the name

examples.text: Do not place the green symbol directly on Deep Ink or across the COP total.
examples.title: Preserve legibility

pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Use typography as the main organizing device. Introduce the chapter with a short heading and a Spanish specimen; avoid ornamental lettering and oversized marketing statements.

examples.text: Consulta el total filtrado y registra un gasto.
examples.title: Tus gastos, a la vista

examples.text: Use IBM Plex Sans throughout; let size, weight and spacing separate tasks rather than adding display faces.
examples.title: Type direction

pages.title: Typography overview
pages.summary: Use IBM Plex Sans for headings, body copy and controls. Keep sentence case, clear accents and tabular figures. Align monetary values to the right.

examples.text: COP 63.700 · 3 gastos
examples.title: Total filtrado

examples.text: Set body text and inputs at 16 px. Use 12–14 px for secondary notes, never for essential field values.
examples.title: Interface texture

pages.title: Primary typeface
pages.summary: IBM Plex Sans is the selected family; distributable files are supplied for weights 400, 500, 600 and 700. Use local font assets for the intended app presentation.

examples.text: Completa el concepto, la categoría, la fecha y el importe.
examples.title: Agregar gasto

examples.text: Keep the name, table, editor and messages in IBM Plex Sans. A system sans-serif may serve only as a loading fallback.
examples.title: Family consistency

pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Use 400 for reading, 500 for labels and controls, and 600 for the name, headings and total. Reserve supplied weight 700 for manual headings, not routine app emphasis.

examples.text: Revisa los datos antes de guardar.
examples.title: Guardar cambios

examples.text: Set Editar gasto at 600, Concepto at 500 and the entered concept at 400. Avoid bolding every label.
examples.title: Weight pairing

examples.text: Use upright text for amounts and status messages. Do not use italics or all caps to signal errors.
examples.title: Style discipline

pages.title: Supporting type
pages.summary: Support the primary hierarchy with the same family, not a second typeface. Keep help text readable, close to its field and free to wrap onto multiple lines.

examples.text: Escribe 18500,50 o 18500.50, sin separadores de miles.
examples.title: Importe en COP

examples.text: Use Soft Sage #536058 for help text and dates. Use semantic red or amber when the message indicates a problem.
examples.title: Secondary information

pages.title: Hierarchy
pages.summary: Use a 28 px screen title, 36 px total, 16 px body and inputs, and 14–16 px buttons. Keep long editing titles multiline rather than shrinking or truncating them.

examples.text: Actualiza los campos y selecciona Guardar cambios.
examples.title: Editar gasto: Almuerzo de ejemplo

examples.text: Make COP 63.700 the strongest item in the summary band; keep Total filtrado and 3 gastos visibly subordinate.
examples.title: Numerical emphasis

pages.title: Layouts
pages.summary: Use a 1180 px desktop canvas with table left and a roughly 360 px editor right. At 768 px and below, place filter and editor before the list; use 16 px mobile margins.

examples.text: Concepto · Categoría · Fecha · Importe en COP
examples.title: Nuevo gasto

examples.text: Keep the editor heading, Guardar gasto and Concepto/Categoría visible on ordinary arrival. Let later fields flow below.
examples.title: 390 × 640 arrival

examples.text: Use 4, 8, 12, 16, 24 and 32 px spacing. Join table and editor with a common top border, not separate floating cards.
examples.title: Spacing rhythm

pages.title: Colors
pages.summary: Introduce color with a Steady Green divider. Use the palette to create quiet contrast and clear actions, not alternating decorative panels.

examples.text: Quiet Paper surrounds white working surfaces; Deep Ink carries content and Steady Green identifies the primary action.
examples.title: Calm workspace

examples.text: Use green for Guardar gasto and selection marks. Do not give each category its own decorative color.
examples.title: One accent

pages.title: Colors overview
pages.summary: Preserve all supplied hex values. Require at least 4.5:1 text contrast and 3:1 for control boundaries and focus indicators. Keep warning and destructive colors distinct from the neutral palette.

examples.text: Quiet Paper #F7F8F2 · Clear Canvas #FFFFFF · Steady Green #246348.
examples.title: Core palette

examples.text: Deep Ink #202A25 for primary text; Soft Sage #536058 for secondary text.
examples.title: Reading palette

examples.text: Use #875900 for warnings and #B42332 for errors and deletion. Neither is replaced by Soft Sage.
examples.title: Semantic colors

pages.title: Using Tints
pages.summary: Keep text, focus rings and the master mark at full color. Optional pale accent washes may support selection, but never replace the solid green selection edge.

examples.text: Use an 8% green wash over white behind Almuerzo de ejemplo, plus a solid #246348 edge and a textual editing title.
examples.title: Selected record

examples.text: Keep No pudimos confirmar el resultado in full-strength warning color; do not lower text opacity.
examples.title: No faded messages

pages.title: Graphic Elements
pages.summary: Build expression from the folded pocket, shared borders and paired selection edges. Avoid textures, currency patterns, chart decorations or extra cards.

examples.text: Reveal green marks beside the selected row and editor together over 160 ms using opacity or transform without shifting content.
examples.title: Paired selection

examples.text: Show both marks immediately and move to the editor without animated scrolling. Preserve the same focus and selected state.
examples.title: Reduced motion

pages.title: Icons
pages.summary: Use simple interface icons only where they help recognition. Pair record actions with visible Spanish labels, and keep icon buttons within at least 44 px touch targets.

examples.text: Show Editar and Eliminar as text, even when accompanied by a pencil or bin icon.
examples.title: Explicit actions

examples.text: Pair a warning icon with No pudimos confirmar el resultado. An icon or color alone must not carry the message.
examples.title: Status language

pages.title: Photography
pages.summary: Do not use photography in the app. Replace lifestyle images, banknotes and stock-finance scenes with clear interface content and generous blank space.

examples.text: Aún no hay gastos. Agrega el primero con el formulario.
examples.title: Empty workspace

examples.text: For a presentation, show a clean crop of the table and editor instead of a person holding a wallet.
examples.title: Editorial alternative

pages.title: Moodboard
pages.summary: Use a material-free moodboard: paper-colored canvas, precise rows, tabular numbers and a folded geometric pocket. Keep references functional rather than nostalgic or financial-luxury themed.

examples.text: A white editor, dark text, a green edge and COP 63.700 communicate the intended compact working atmosphere.
examples.title: Visual anchors

examples.text: Avoid leather textures, gold accents, handwritten ledgers, glass effects and dashboard-style metric tiles.
examples.title: Exclude

pages.title: Applications
pages.summary: Label application layouts as design studies. Carry the same pocket, type hierarchy and restrained palette into every format without implying extra product features or commercial services.

examples.text: Registra gastos en COP y consulta el total por categoría.
examples.title: Bolsillo Gastos

examples.text: Use Design study outside the artwork. Keep specimen copy inside the artwork natural and user-facing.
examples.title: Study caption

pages.title: Social media icons
pages.summary: Design study: center the master pocket on Quiet Paper for a profile icon. Allow circular cropping without clipping the fold; do not squeeze the business name into the icon.

examples.text: Gastos personales en COP.
examples.title: Bolsillo Gastos

examples.text: Keep the complete 160-unit master canvas inside the central 80% of the profile image.
examples.title: Crop rule

pages.title: Social media profiles
pages.summary: Design study: pair the pocket avatar with the exact business name and a factual, brief description. Do not invent an account handle, audience size or official social presence.

examples.text: Use a Quiet Paper banner with one restrained interface crop. Keep private records and session details out of imagery.

pages.title: Posters
pages.summary: Design study: use a large task-led headline, the pocket lockup and a simplified screen composition. Do not add invented URLs, download badges or promotional claims.

examples.text: Give the headline most of the upper third. Place one table/editor composition below, with no photography or metric cards.

pages.title: T shirts and totes
pages.summary: Design study: use the pocket and name as a restrained identity application, not merchandise advertising. Keep the mark green on a light support and avoid repeating it as a pattern.

examples.text: Gastos en COP.
examples.title: Bolsillo Gastos

examples.text: Use one small chest lockup or a centered tote lockup. Preserve clear space equal to one quarter of the symbol width.
examples.title: Print placement

pages.title: Document sleeve
pages.summary: Design study: adapt packaging to a printed reference sleeve, not a product shipment. Use Quiet Paper, a small green pocket and a single descriptive label; imply no export or delivery feature.

examples.text: Place the lockup at the upper left and the document title below. Leave the remaining face unpatterned.

pages.title: Workspace entry
pages.summary: Design study: the destination is the working screen at /, not a landing page or physical pickup point. Show the name, total band and editor immediately; do not introduce an onboarding gate.

pages.summary: Design study: place the primary save action in the editor heading and Cancelar nearby. Keep save available for validation; disable only during incompatible operations. Use 4 px corner radii.

examples.title: Guardar gasto

examples.text: Use white text on green for saving, visible focus and 44 px targets. Keep Editar and Eliminar explicit in each record.

pages.title: Save confirmation
pages.summary: Design study: show confirmation beside the save action, never on a receipt page. Update totals only from confirmed server data and preserve the identity of the saved record.

examples.text: Almuerzo de ejemplo · Alimentación · COP 18.500. Agregar otro gasto.

examples.text: Keep feedback in the editor with flexible height. Do not insert a false row when the saved expense falls outside the active filter.
examples.title: Confirmation placement

pages.title: Category reference card
pages.summary: Design study: replace a rewards card with a practical category reference. Show the six fixed labels without points, membership tiers, benefits or a scannable account identifier.

examples.text: Alimentación · Transporte · Hogar · Salud · Ocio · Otros
examples.title: Elige una categoría

examples.text: Use two columns of three labels beneath the pocket lockup. Keep all labels in Deep Ink rather than category colors.

pages.title: Workspace sign
pages.summary: Design study: use a presentation placard rather than implying a store or office location. Keep the pocket, name and one descriptive line readable from a distance.

examples.text: Registro personal de gastos en COP.
examples.title: Bolsillo Gastos

examples.text: On a Deep Ink panel, use a white name and the green pocket on Quiet Paper. Add no address, opening hours or service claims.

pages.title: Expense app
pages.summary: Design study: / is the only screen. Arrange one filtered total band above the table/editor workspace. Saved records are intended to persist in Turso through server-side API routes, not local mock data.

examples.text: COP 63.700 · 3 gastos · Todas las categorías
examples.title: Total filtrado

examples.text: Show Ejemplo on Almuerzo de ejemplo, Bus de ejemplo and Compra de ejemplo. Do not restore deleted examples or present them as personal entries.
examples.title: Seed presentation

examples.text: Use two lines for record data and a third for Editar and Eliminar. Wrap long concepts without horizontal scrolling or truncation.
examples.title: Mobile records

pages.title: Favicon
pages.summary: Design study: reuse the master pocket geometry for app/icon.svg and raster app icons. Use a Quiet Paper support surface; omit lettering, extra outlines and starter artwork.

examples.text: Registra y consulta gastos en COP.
examples.title: Bolsillo Gastos

examples.text: Keep the entire pocket and detached fold visible. Scale the master uniformly rather than redrawing it for a different size.
examples.title: Small icon composition

pages.title: Stationery
pages.summary: Design study: build reference documents on white or Quiet Paper with a small top-left lockup. Use a consistent left edge, restrained footer and no invented legal or contact details.

examples.text: Concepto · Categoría · Fecha · Importe en COP
examples.title: Notas de gastos

examples.text: Use a single green rule below the heading. Align numerical columns right and keep descriptive text left aligned.
examples.title: Page structure

pages.title: Business cards
pages.summary: Design study: use a project introduction card without invented people, titles, phone numbers or addresses. Let the exact business name and factual product description carry the format.

examples.title: Bolsillo Gastos

examples.text: Front: pocket and name on Quiet Paper. Reverse: one short description in Deep Ink; no fake QR code or contact placeholder.

pages.title: Quick-start card
pages.summary: Design study: replace a gift card with a compact task guide. Avoid balances, redemption codes or implied payments; organize the instructions as three short steps.

examples.text: Completa los cuatro campos, selecciona Guardar gasto y espera la confirmación.

examples.text: Para el importe, escribe 18500,50 o 18500.50, sin separadores de miles.

examples.text: Use a 600-weight heading, numbered steps in 400 and one green action label. Leave ample space between steps.
examples.title: Card hierarchy

pages.title: Document seal
pages.summary: Design study: use the pocket as a small identifier on reference-document closures, not a certification stamp. Preserve the master geometry and avoid language implying verified or secure financial data.

examples.text: Guía de referencia.
examples.title: Bolsillo Gastos

examples.text: Place the green symbol on a Quiet Paper label with a quarter-symbol clear zone. Do not add checkmarks, stars or circular certification text.
examples.title: Seal layout

pages.title: Customer support
pages.summary: Design study: keep help inside the editor or workspace and name the next safe action. Distinguish unavailable sessions, failed refreshes, uncertain sends and conflicts without inventing a support channel.

brandbook.voice: Español directo, breve y concreto. Acciones nombradas, importes inequívocos y mensajes que distinguen borrador, envío incierto y guardado. Sin promesas comerciales ni vocabulario técnico innecesario.
